Trailer forms of both kinds and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images, not as text, so this review can confirm that a photo was taken and when, but not what it shows.

A second limitation specific to today: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central on 10/14, so the following-morning sweep for late arrivals could not be performed. Any 10/14 form submitted after that hour will not appear here. Five submissions that arrived inside today's window carry a form date of 10/13 — two Jerry Gonzales air jobs at Turner W41K 11H and Turner W41L 12H, Jeremy Norris's Trailer Readiness Form for trailer 507, Larry Jaramillo's Trailer Inspection Form for trailer 603, and Rolando Flores's H2S daily for H&P 616. They were read but belong to 10/13 and are not counted toward today's coverage.

91 of 91 submissions read. The job board was available: the 10/14/2026 ArkLaTex and Permian Basin boards emailed by Blake Walton at 10:07 AM Central were used, and 56 manned board rows were checked for coverage after excluding cancelled, on-standby, days-off, WTX support and shop rows.
